Do you have a track record in financial product sales? Are you a target driven individual? Do you know how to come up with innovative solutions for clients? We are looking for someone who can:

• introduce, develop and maintain relationships with clients by understanding their objectives, risk tolerance and expectations
• manage the end-to-end client management process
